name: DevDome Analytics
line: Website traffic and outbound-click analytics with bot reports.

free.text: Free: 50,000 human pageviews/month, unlimited sites, 90-day history

cells.cookieless: Yes by default; optional visitor cookies

pv.math: 10,000 pageviews fit the free allowance of 50,000 a month.
100,000 pageviews fit the Pro plan's allowance of 500,000 a month. Billed monthly.
1,000,000 pageviews fit the Business plan's allowance of 2,000,000 a month. Billed monthly.
